The Funding, Research Administration and Projects Ontology (FRAPO)

http://purl.org/cerif/frapo
bibliographic citation
David Shotton. The Funding, Research Administration and Projects Ontology. Revision: 1.2.0. http://purl.org/spar/frapo.
code repository
https://github.com/SPAROntologies/frapo
contributor
Silvio Peroni (https://orcid.org/0000-0003-0530-4305)
Sebastian Barzaghi (https://orcid.org/0000-0002-0799-1527)
creator
David Shotton (https://orcid.org/0000-0001-5506-523X)
date
2026-08-14
description
The **_Funding, Research Administration and Projects Ontology (FRAPO)_** is a [CERIF-compliant](http://www.eurocris.org/cerif/main-features-cerif) ontology for describing administrative information relating to grant funding and research projects. It can be used for the characterization of grant applications (e.g., `frapo:Grant`), funding bodies (e.g., `frapo:University`), research projects, project partners, etc.; in other words, the sort of information stored in Current Research Information Systems (CRIS). It can also be used to describe other types of projects, for example building projects and educational projects. FRAPO, which is written in OWL 2 DL, imports [FOAF](http://xmlns.com/foaf/spec/) for characterizing people. FRAPO is designed to be used in conjunction with [SCoRO](https://www.sparontologies.net/ontologies/scoro) that provides structured vocabulary terms to describe the contributions (`scoro:Contribution`) and roles of scholars (`pro:Role`), and the organizations of which they are members, with respect to projects, research investigations and other academic activities describable using FRAPO, and to the scholarly journal articles and other outputs that result from them. ![The main architecture of FRAPO.](frapo.png) Terms for documents of relevance to the scholarly domain covered by FRAPO, including grant applications, project plans, project reports, datasets and journal articles, are already provided by [FaBiO](https://www.sparontologies.net/ontologies/fabio) and are therefore not included within FRAPO. FRAPO also permits descriptions of various types of applications, funding programs, infrastructure entities (e.g., services and research facilities), and a wide range of financial entities (e.g., accounts, contracts, quotations, purchases, invoices and payments), and the relationships between them (e.g., has application outcome, is manufactured by, is purchased by, has dispatch date, has purchase order number, has acronym) not shown in the diagram above. ## Examples of use In the following subsections, we introduce some examples to showcase how to use FRAPO. The prefixes that are used in all the examples provided below are defined as follows: @prefix : <http://www.sparontologies.net/example/> . @prefix fabio: <http://purl.org/spar/fabio/> . @prefix foaf: <http://xmlns.com/foaf/0.1/> . @prefix frapo: <http://purl.org/cerif/frapo/> . @prefix person: <http://data.semanticweb.org/person/> . @prefix org: <http://data.semanticweb.org/organization/> . @prefix pro: <http://purl.org/spar/pro/> . @prefix scoro: <http://purl.org/spar/scoro/> . ### Describing fundings, investigations and research outputs The specification of the connection between a research paper, the investigation done and discussed in it and the funds that allowed such investigation are important aspects to describe in the paper itself. Usually, such aspects are introduced in a footnote or, even better, in an appropriate acknowledgement section that describe them in natural language. The use of FRAPO in combination with other SPAR Ontologies such as FaBiO and SCoRO permits the description of the aforementioned aspects in RDF. For instance, the well-known paper published by a young Peter Mika and entitled "Ontologies are us: a unified model of social networks and semantics" has been one of the outcomes of Mika's investigation founded by his Ph.D. scholarship. FRAPO allows one to explicitly describe all of this by means of its several classes and properties. org:vrije-universiteit-amsterdam a frapo:University ; foaf:name "Free University Amsterdam"@en ; frapo:awards :phd-scholarship-2004 . :investigation a frapo:Investigation ; frapo:hasOutput <http://dx.doi.org/10.1016/j.websem.2006.11.002> . :phd-scholarship-2004 a frapo:Scholarship ; foaf:name "Ph.D. Scholarship 2004" ; frapo:funds :investigation . person:peter-mika a foaf:Person ; foaf:name "Peter Mika" ; pro:holdsRoleInTime :affiliation-vua ; scoro:makesContribution :mika-writes-draft , :mika-revises-manuscript . :mika-writes-draft a scoro:ContributionSituation ; scoro:withContribution scoro:writes-manuscript-draft ; scoro:withContributionEffort scoro:solo-effort ; scoro:relatesToEntity <http://dx.doi.org/10.1016/j.websem.2006.11.002> . :mika-revises-manuscript a scoro:ContributionSituation ; scoro:withContribution scoro:revises-manuscript ; scoro:withContributionEffort scoro:solo-effort ; scoro:relatesToEntity <http://dx.doi.org/10.1016/j.websem.2006.11.002> . :affiliation-vua a pro:RoleInTime ; pro:withRole scoro:affiliate ; pro:relatesToOrganization org:vrije-universiteit-amsterdam ; pro:relatesToDocument <http://dx.doi.org/10.1016/j.websem.2006.11.002> . ## Competency Questions FRAPO can be used for answering several questions related to administrative information about grant funding and research projects. In the following subsections, some of them are introduced together with their respective SPARQL queries. The prefixes that are used in all the SPARQL queries provided below are defined as follows: PREFIX frapo: <http://purl.org/cerif/frapo/> PREFIX scoro: <http://purl.org/spar/scoro/> PREFIX foaf: <http://xmlns.com/foaf/0.1/> PREFIX pro: <http://purl.org/spar/pro/> ### CQ1 Which funding awards or scholarships are granted by a university? SELECT ?university ?universityName ?award ?awardName WHERE { ?university a frapo:University ; frapo:awards ?award . OPTIONAL { ?university foaf:name ?universityName . } OPTIONAL { ?award foaf:name ?awardName . } } ### CQ2 Which investigation is funded by a specific scholarship? SELECT ?fundingAward ?awardName ?investigation WHERE { ?fundingAward a frapo:Scholarship ; frapo:funds ?investigation . ?investigation a frapo:Investigation . OPTIONAL { ?fundingAward foaf:name ?awardName . } } ### CQ3 What outputs are produced by an investigation? SELECT ?investigation ?outputDocument WHERE { ?investigation a frapo:Investigation ; frapo:hasOutput ?outputDocument . } ### CQ4 Which funding awards granted by a university finance an investigation that produced a document to which an author is affiliated? SELECT ?person ?university ?award ?investigation ?document WHERE { ?person a foaf:Person ; pro:holdsRoleInTime ?roleInTime . ?roleInTime pro:relatesToOrganization ?university ; pro:relatesToDocument ?document . ?university a frapo:University ; frapo:awards ?award . ?award frapo:funds ?investigation . ?investigation frapo:hasOutput ?document . } ### CQ5 What specific contributions are made by a person toward an output document resulting from a funded investigation? SELECT ?person ?contributionType ?effort ?document ?investigation WHERE { ?person a foaf:Person ; scoro:makesContribution ?situation . ?situation a scoro:ContributionSituation ; scoro:withContribution ?contributionType ; scoro:relatesToEntity ?document . ?investigation a frapo:Investigation ; frapo:hasOutput ?document . OPTIONAL { ?situation scoro:withContributionEffort ?effort . } }

@prefix frapo: <http://purl.org/cerif/frapo/> .
@prefix owl: <http://www.w3.org/2002/07/owl#> .
@prefix rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#> .
@prefix reg: <http://purl.org/linked-data/registry#> .
@prefix vann: <http://purl.org/vocab/vann/> .
@prefix vs: <http://www.w3.org/2003/06/sw-vocab-status/ns#> .

frapo:Account a owl:Class ;
    rdfs:label "account"@en ;
    vann:example """
    :my-account a frapo:Account ;
        frapo:hasAccountNumber "ACC-987654" .
    """ ;
    rdfs:comment "A mechanism for administering money, typically owned by an agent and dedicated to a particular purpose, for example the equipment account of a university department, to be used only for the purchase or maintenance of items of equipment. "@en ;
    rdfs:isDefinedBy frapo: ;
    rdfs:subClassOf frapo:FinancialEntity ;
    vs:term_status reg:statusStable .

@prefix frapo: <http://purl.org/cerif/frapo/> .
@prefix owl: <http://www.w3.org/2002/07/owl#> .
@prefix rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#> .
@prefix reg: <http://purl.org/linked-data/registry#> .
@prefix vann: <http://purl.org/vocab/vann/> .
@prefix vs: <http://www.w3.org/2003/06/sw-vocab-status/ns#> .

frapo:AccountStatement a owl:Class ;
    rdfs:label "account statement"@en ;
    vann:example """
	:my-account-statement a frapo:AccountStatement ;
        frapo:hasMonetaryValue "5000"^^xsd:decimal ; 
        frapo:hasCurrency "EUR" .
    """ ;
    rdfs:comment "A statement of income and expenditure for an account, typically presented as dated income receipts and outgoings against categories in a budget for that account."@en ;
    rdfs:isDefinedBy frapo: ;
    rdfs:subClassOf frapo:FinancialEntity ;
    vs:term_status reg:statusStable .

c

back to ToC or Class ToC

IRI: http://purl.org/cerif/frapo/BudgetCategory

comment
A category of expenditure within a budget, determining what the allocated money can be spent on, for example salaries, equipment, travel.
en
individuals with this type
building costsni,
consultancy costsni,
consumables costsni,
contributions in kindni,
directly allocated costsni,
directly incurred costsni,
estates costsni,
facilities costsni,
full economic costsni,
indirect costsni,
non-staff costsni,
other costsni,
overhead costsni,
publishing costsni,
service costsni,
software costsni,
travel and subsistence costsni
is defined by
http://purl.org/cerif/frapo/
is in range of
has budget categoryop
is sub concept of
financial entityc
label
budget category
en
example
:my-budget a frapo:Budget ; frapo:hasBudgetInformation :my-budgeted-amout . :my-budgeted-amount a frapo:BudgetedAmount ; frapo:hasBudgetCategory frapo:facilities-costs . frapo:facilities-costs a frapo:BudgetCategory .
term status
status stable

@prefix frapo: <http://purl.org/cerif/frapo/> .
@prefix owl: <http://www.w3.org/2002/07/owl#> .
@prefix rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#> .
@prefix reg: <http://purl.org/linked-data/registry#> .
@prefix vann: <http://purl.org/vocab/vann/> .
@prefix vs: <http://www.w3.org/2003/06/sw-vocab-status/ns#> .

frapo:BudgetCategory a owl:Class ;
    rdfs:label "budget category"@en ;
    vann:example """
    :my-budget a frapo:Budget ;
        frapo:hasBudgetInformation :my-budgeted-amout .
    
    :my-budgeted-amount a frapo:BudgetedAmount ;
        frapo:hasBudgetCategory frapo:facilities-costs .

    frapo:facilities-costs a frapo:BudgetCategory .
    """ ;
    rdfs:comment "A category of expenditure within a budget, determining what the allocated money can be spent on, for example salaries, equipment, travel."@en ;
    rdfs:isDefinedBy frapo: ;
    rdfs:subClassOf frapo:FinancialEntity ;
    vs:term_status reg:statusStable .

IRI: http://purl.org/cerif/frapo/Bursary

comment

en

http://purl.org/cerif/frapo/
is sub concept of
fundingc
label
bursary
en
term status
status stable
example

    vs:term_status reg:statusStable .

IRI: http://purl.org/cerif/frapo/College

comment
An academic organization that is either a small degree-giving university, or (in the OxBridge sense) an independent corporation of scholars within a larger university, providing undergraduate tuition and a social environment for its students and fellows.
en
is defined by
http://purl.org/cerif/frapo/
is sub concept of
organizationc
label
college
en
term status
status stable
example
:my-college a frapo:College ; foaf:name "Trinity College" ; frapo:collaboratesWith :my-university . 

@prefix foaf: <http://xmlns.com/foaf/0.1/> .
@prefix frapo: <http://purl.org/cerif/frapo/> .

@prefix rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#> .
@prefix reg: <http://purl.org/linked-data/registry#> .
@prefix vann: <http://purl.org/vocab/vann/> .
@prefix vs: <http://www.w3.org/2003/06/sw-vocab-status/ns#> .

frapo:College a owl:Class ;
    rdfs:label "college"@en ;
    vann:example """
    :my-college a frapo:College ;
        foaf:name "Trinity College" ;
        frapo:collaboratesWith :my-university .
    """ ;
    rdfs:comment "An academic organization that is either a small degree-giving university, or (in the OxBridge sense) an independent corporation of scholars within a larger university, providing undergraduate tuition and a social environment for its students and fellows."@en ;
    rdfs:isDefinedBy frapo: ;
    rdfs:subClassOf foaf:Organization ;
    vs:term_status reg:statusStable .

is defined by
http://purl.org/cerif/frapo/
is sub concept of
agentc
label
computational agent
en

term status
status stable

endeavour
c

back to ToC or Class ToC

IRI: http://purl.org/cerif/frapo/Endeavour

comment
An activity, such as a research investigation, that is enabled by a project.
en
is defined by
http://purl.org/cerif/frapo/
is sub concept of
thingc
label
endeavour
en
note
An endeavour relates to the academic and practical aspects of undertaking that endeavour - thus for a research investigation the research itself, including the hypotheses being investigated, the experiments being undertaken, the data being gathered and analysed, the interpretations being drawn from the data, and the results obtained. In contrast, the project relates to the administrative aspects of undertaking an endeavour, including the funding obtained, the people employed, and the management of the project in terms of deadlines and deliverables.
en
example
:my-endeavour a frapo:Endeavour ; frapo:isEnabledBy :my-project .
term status
status stable

@prefix frapo: <http://purl.org/cerif/frapo/> .
@prefix owl: <http://www.w3.org/2002/07/owl#> .
@prefix rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#> .
@prefix reg: <http://purl.org/linked-data/registry#> .
@prefix skos: <http://www.w3.org/2004/02/skos/core#> .
@prefix vann: <http://purl.org/vocab/vann/> .
@prefix vs: <http://www.w3.org/2003/06/sw-vocab-status/ns#> .

frapo:Endeavour a owl:Class ;
    rdfs:label "endeavour"@en ;
    vann:example """
    :my-endeavour a frapo:Endeavour ;
        frapo:isEnabledBy :my-project .
    """ ;
    rdfs:comment "An activity, such as a research investigation, that is enabled by a project."@en ;
    rdfs:isDefinedBy frapo: ;
    rdfs:subClassOf owl:Thing ;
    vs:term_status reg:statusStable ;
    skos:note """
 An endeavour relates to the academic and practical aspects of undertaking that endeavour - thus for a research investigation the research itself, including the hypotheses being investigated, the experiments being undertaken, the data being gathered and analysed, the interpretations being drawn from the data, and the results obtained. 
 In contrast, the project relates to the administrative aspects of undertaking an endeavour, including the funding obtained, the people employed, and the management of the project in terms of deadlines and deliverables.
    """@en .

investigation
c

back to ToC or Class ToC

IRI: http://purl.org/cerif/frapo/Investigation

comment
An investigation is an endeavour that involves research, enabled by a project.
en
is defined by
http://purl.org/cerif/frapo/
is sub concept of
endeavourc
label
investigation
en
example
:my-investigation a frapo:Investigation ; frapo:hasOutput <http://doi.org/10.1016/j.websem.2006.11.002> .
note
The investigation relate to the scholarly and practical aspects of conducting the research itself, including the hypotheses being investigated, the experiments being undertaken, the data being gathered and analysed, the interpretations being drawn from the data, and the results obtained. In contrast, the project that enables it encompasses the administrative aspects of undertaking the endeavour, including the funding obtained, the people employed, and the management of the project in terms of deadlines and deliverables.
en
term status
status stable

@prefix frapo: <http://purl.org/cerif/frapo/> .
@prefix owl: <http://www.w3.org/2002/07/owl#> .
@prefix rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#> .
@prefix reg: <http://purl.org/linked-data/registry#> .
@prefix skos: <http://www.w3.org/2004/02/skos/core#> .
@prefix vann: <http://purl.org/vocab/vann/> .
@prefix vs: <http://www.w3.org/2003/06/sw-vocab-status/ns#> .

frapo:Investigation a owl:Class ;
    rdfs:label "investigation"@en ;
    vann:example """
    :my-investigation a frapo:Investigation ;
        frapo:hasOutput <http://doi.org/10.1016/j.websem.2006.11.002> .
    """ ;
    rdfs:comment """
An investigation is an endeavour that involves research, enabled by a project.  
"""@en ;
    rdfs:isDefinedBy frapo: ;
    rdfs:subClassOf frapo:Endeavour ;
    vs:term_status reg:statusStable ;
    skos:note """
The investigation relate to the scholarly and practical aspects of conducting the research itself, including the hypotheses being investigated, the experiments being undertaken, the data being gathered and analysed, the interpretations being drawn from the data, and the results obtained.  
In contrast, the project that enables it encompasses the administrative aspects of undertaking the endeavour, including the funding obtained, the people employed, and the management of the project in terms of deadlines and deliverables.
    """@en .

c

back to ToC or Class ToC

IRI: http://purl.org/cerif/frapo/Output

comment
Something that is created or produced as a result of a project or an endeavour. Examples include a building resulting from a building project, educated students graduating from an educational programme, and a journal article published as a result of a research project. Research outputs can also include reports, datasets, experimental protocols, workflows and mathematical models, and material outputs such as a cell line, a mouse mutant or a new form of microscope.
en
is defined by
http://purl.org/cerif/frapo/
is sub concept of
equipmentc,
thingc
label
output
en
note
Ontology terms and definitions for most publishable project outputs are given as "Expression" classes in FaBiO, the FRBR-aligned Bibliographic Ontology, e.g. `fabio:JournalArticle`, `fabio:DataSet`. For "deliverables", use `frapo:Deliverable`. For material outputs, use `frapo:MaterialOutput`.
en
example
:my-output a frapo:Output ; dcterms:title "Bibliographic References Dataset"@en .
term status
status stable

@prefix owl: <http://www.w3.org/2002/07/owl#> .
@prefix rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#> .
@prefix reg: <http://purl.org/linked-data/registry#> .

frapo:Output a owl:Class ;
    rdfs:label "output"@en ;
    vann:example """
    :my-output a frapo:Output ;
        dcterms:title "Bibliographic References Dataset"@en .
    """ ;
    rdfs:comment "Something that is created or produced as a result of a project or an endeavour. Examples include a building resulting from a building project, educated students graduating from an educational programme, and a journal article published as a result of a research project. Research outputs can also include reports, datasets, experimental protocols, workflows and mathematical models, and material outputs such as a cell line, a mouse mutant or a new form of microscope."@en ;
    rdfs:isDefinedBy frapo: ;
    rdfs:subClassOf frapo:Equipment,
        owl:Thing ;
    vs:term_status reg:statusStable ;
    skos:note "Ontology terms and definitions for most publishable project outputs are given as \"Expression\" classes in FaBiO, the FRBR-aligned Bibliographic Ontology, e.g. `fabio:JournalArticle`, `fabio:DataSet`. For \"deliverables\", use `frapo:Deliverable`. For material outputs, use `frapo:MaterialOutput`."@en .

project
c

back to ToC or Class ToC

IRI: http://xmlns.com/foaf/0.1/Project

comment
An administrative entity that enables an endeavour such as a research investigation. A project relates to the administrative aspects of undertaking an endeavour, including the funding obtained, the people employed, and the management of the project in terms of deadlines and deliverables. In contrast, an endeavour such as a research investigation relate to the academic and practical aspects of undertaking that endeavour - thus for a research investigation: the research itself, including the hypotheses being investigated, the experiments being undertaken, the data being gathered and analysed, the interpretations being drawn from the data, and the results obtained.
en
is defined by
http://xmlns.com/foaf/0.1/
is in domain of
has project identifierdp
label
project
en

foaf:Project a owl:Class ;
    rdfs:label "project"@en ;
    rdfs:comment "An administrative entity that enables an endeavour such as a research investigation.  A project relates to the administrative aspects of undertaking an endeavour, including the funding obtained, the people employed, and the management of the project in terms of deadlines and deliverables.  In contrast, an endeavour such as a research investigation relate to the academic and practical aspects of undertaking that endeavour - thus for a research investigation: the research itself, including the hypotheses being investigated, the experiments being undertaken, the data being gathered and analysed, the interpretations being drawn from the data, and the results obtained."@en ;
    rdfs:isDefinedBy foaf: .

IRI: http://purl.org/cerif/frapo/Quotation

comment
A formal statement of promise (usually provided in response to a request for quotation) by potential supplier to supply goods or services at specified prices and within a specified period. Acceptance of the quotation by the buyer constitutes an agreement binding on both parties.
en
is defined by
http://purl.org/cerif/frapo/
is sub concept of
financial entityc
label
quotation
en
see also
quotation.html
term status
status stable
example
:my-quotation a frapo:Quotation ; frapo:hasMonetaryValue "10000000"^^xsd:decimal ; frapo:hasCurrency "EUR" . 

@prefix frapo: <http://purl.org/cerif/frapo/> .
@prefix owl: <http://www.w3.org/2002/07/owl#> .
@prefix rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#> .
@prefix reg: <http://purl.org/linked-data/registry#> .
@prefix vann: <http://purl.org/vocab/vann/> .
@prefix vs: <http://www.w3.org/2003/06/sw-vocab-status/ns#> .

frapo:Quotation a owl:Class ;
    rdfs:label "quotation"@en ;
    vann:example """
    :my-quotation a frapo:Quotation ;
        frapo:hasMonetaryValue "10000000"^^xsd:decimal ; 
        frapo:hasCurrency "EUR" .
    """ ;
    rdfs:comment """
A formal statement of promise (usually provided in response to a request for quotation) by potential supplier to supply goods or services at specified prices and within a specified period. Acceptance of the quotation by the buyer constitutes an agreement binding on both parties.
"""@en ;
    rdfs:isDefinedBy frapo: ;
    rdfs:seeAlso <http://www.businessdictionary.com/definition/quotation.html> ;
    rdfs:subClassOf frapo:FinancialEntity ;
    vs:term_status reg:statusStable .

IRI: http://purl.org/cerif/frapo/RegistrationAgency

comment
An institution or organization officially appointed by a Registration Authority that acts to register things. For example, CrossRef is a registration agency for DOIs relating to documents, while DataCite is a registration agency for DOIs relating to datasets, acting for the Registration Authority for DOIs, namely the International DOI Foundation (IDF).
en
is defined by
http://purl.org/cerif/frapo/
is sub concept of
organizationc
label
registration agency
en
term status
status stable
example
:my-registration-agency a frapo:RegistrationAgency ; foaf:name "CrossRef" .

IRI: http://purl.org/cerif/frapo/RegistrationAuthority

comment
An agent with responsibility for registering and maintaining international standards, internet domain names, patents, controlled vocabularies and other similar entities required for reliable international cooperatative activities. For example, the International DOI Foundation (IDF) is the Registration Authority for DOIs.
en
is defined by
http://purl.org/cerif/frapo/
is sub concept of
organizationc
label
registration authority
en
term status
status stable

frapo:isEmployedBy a owl:ObjectProperty ;
    rdfs:label "is employed by"@en ;
    vann:example """
    :my-person a foaf:Person ;
        frapo:isEmployedBy :my-university .

    :my-university a frapo:University .
    """ ;
    rdfs:comment "The relation between an employed agent, typically a person or an organization, and an employing agent."@en ;
    rdfs:domain foaf:Agent ;
    rdfs:isDefinedBy frapo: ;
    rdfs:range foaf:Agent ;
    vs:term_status reg:statusStable ;
    skos:note "This property should not be used for the other meaning of \"employ\", meaning to use something, e.g. \"Great skill is employed by master craftsmen . . .\"/"@en .

IRI: http://purl.org/cerif/frapo/isFundedBy

comment
The relation between something and the funding that funds it (i.e. that finances or pays for it), or to the funding agency providing that funding. This flexibility is given because of alternative usages of the English word "funds".
en

is supported byop
domain
thingc
range
(
fundingc
or
agentc
)
is defined by
http://purl.org/cerif/frapo/
is inverse of
fundsop
label
is funded by
en
see also
is awarded byop,
has funding agencyop
example
:my-project frapo:isFundedBy :my-grant .
term status
status stable

@prefix vs: <http://www.w3.org/2003/06/sw-vocab-status/ns#> .

frapo:isFundedBy a owl:ObjectProperty ;
    rdfs:label "is funded by"@en ;
    vann:example """
    :my-project 
        frapo:isFundedBy :my-grant .
    """ ;
    rdfs:comment """
The relation between something and the funding that funds it (i.e. that finances or pays for it), or to the funding agency providing that funding.
This flexibility is given because of alternative usages of the English word "funds".  
"""@en ;
    rdfs:isDefinedBy frapo: ;
    rdfs:seeAlso frapo:hasFundingAgency,
        frapo:isAwardedBy ;
    rdfs:subPropertyOf frapo:isSupportedBy ;
    vs:term_status reg:statusStable .

example
:my-project frapo:isSupportedBy :my-funding . :my-funding a frapo:Funding . 

@prefix foaf: <http://xmlns.com/foaf/0.1/> .
@prefix frapo: <http://purl.org/cerif/frapo/> .
@prefix owl: <http://www.w3.org/2002/07/owl#> .
@prefix rdf: <http://www.w3.org/1999/02/22-rdf-syntax-ns#> .
@prefix rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#> .
@prefix reg: <http://purl.org/linked-data/registry#> .
@prefix skos: <http://www.w3.org/2004/02/skos/core#> .
@prefix vann: <http://purl.org/vocab/vann/> .
@prefix vs: <http://www.w3.org/2003/06/sw-vocab-status/ns#> .

frapo:isSupportedBy a owl:ObjectProperty ;
    rdfs:label "is supported by"@en ;
    vann:example """
    :my-project 
        frapo:isSupportedBy :my-funding .
    
    :my-funding a frapo:Funding .
    """ ;
    rdfs:comment "The relation between something and an agent that provides funding or other support for it."@en ;
    rdfs:isDefinedBy frapo: ;
    rdfs:range [ a owl:Class ;
            owl:unionOf ( frapo:Funding foaf:Agent ) ] ;
    owl:inverseOf frapo:supports ;
    vs:term_status reg:statusStable ;
    skos:note "This property is not intended for use to describe mechanical or physical support, as in \"The statue is supported by the plinth\". "@en .

has job title
dp

back to ToC or Data Property ToC

IRI: http://purl.org/cerif/frapo/hasJobTitle

comment
The job title held by a person, such as might appear next to the name in a directory or on a conference name badge. For example, the person's specific job title might be "Linacre Professor of Zoology" or "Regius Professor of Moral Philosophy".
en
is sub property of
has personal informationdp
domain
personc
range
literal
is defined by
http://purl.org/cerif/frapo/
label
has job title
en
see also
with job title
note
This job title properly refers to the **role** held by that person (e.g. "Head of Department"), which can be separately defined using SCoRO, the Scholarly Contributions and Roles Ontology (http://purl.org/spar/scoro/).
en
example
:my-person a foaf:Person ; frapo:hasJobTitle "Associate Professor" .
term status
status stable

@prefix foaf: <http://xmlns.com/foaf/0.1/> .
@prefix frapo: <http://purl.org/cerif/frapo/> .
@prefix owl: <http://www.w3.org/2002/07/owl#> .
@prefix rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#> .
@prefix reg: <http://purl.org/linked-data/registry#> .
@prefix scoro: <http://purl.org/spar/scoro/> .
@prefix skos: <http://www.w3.org/2004/02/skos/core#> .
@prefix vann: <http://purl.org/vocab/vann/> .
@prefix vs: <http://www.w3.org/2003/06/sw-vocab-status/ns#> .

frapo:hasJobTitle a owl:DatatypeProperty ;
    rdfs:label "has job title"@en ;
    vann:example """
    :my-person a foaf:Person ;
        frapo:hasJobTitle "Associate Professor" .
    """ ;
    rdfs:comment """The job title held by a person, such as might appear next to the name in a directory or on a conference name badge. For example, the person's specific job title might be "Linacre Professor of Zoology" or "Regius Professor of Moral Philosophy". 
"""@en ;
    rdfs:domain foaf:Person ;
    rdfs:isDefinedBy frapo: ;
    rdfs:seeAlso scoro:withJobTitle ;
    rdfs:subPropertyOf frapo:hasPersonalInformation ;
    vs:term_status reg:statusStable ;
    skos:note """
This job title properly refers to the **role** held by that person (e.g. "Head of Department"), which can be separately defined using SCoRO, the Scholarly Contributions and Roles Ontology (http://purl.org/spar/scoro/).
    """@en .

directly allocated costs
ni

back to ToC or Named Individual ToC

IRI: http://purl.org/cerif/frapo/directly-allocated-costs

comment
A budget category to cover those costs normally borne by an institution, that are assigned to the budget of an externally funded project to cover the value of contributions to that project, for example to pay for the salary of a permanent member of staff seconded to work on the project, to compensate the employing organization for the loss of that person's efforts on other activities that he or she would otherwise be undertaking were it not for that secondment.
en
is defined by
http://purl.org/cerif/frapo/
label
directly allocated costs
en
type
budget categoryc
example
:my-budget a frapo:Budget ; frapo:hasBudgetInformation :my-budgeted-amout . :my-budgeted-amount a frapo:BudgetedAmount ; frapo:hasBudgetCategory frapo:directly-allocated-costs .
term status
status stable

@prefix frapo: <http://purl.org/cerif/frapo/> .
@prefix owl: <http://www.w3.org/2002/07/owl#> .
@prefix rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#> .
@prefix reg: <http://purl.org/linked-data/registry#> .
@prefix vann: <http://purl.org/vocab/vann/> .
@prefix vs: <http://www.w3.org/2003/06/sw-vocab-status/ns#> .

frapo:directly-allocated-costs a frapo:BudgetCategory,
        owl:NamedIndividual ;
    rdfs:label "directly allocated costs"@en ;
    vann:example """
    :my-budget a frapo:Budget ;
        frapo:hasBudgetInformation :my-budgeted-amout .
    
    :my-budgeted-amount a frapo:BudgetedAmount ;
        frapo:hasBudgetCategory frapo:directly-allocated-costs .
    """ ;
    rdfs:comment "A budget category to cover those costs normally borne by an institution, that are assigned to the budget of an externally funded project to cover the value of contributions to that project, for example to pay for the salary of a permanent member of staff seconded to work on the project, to compensate the employing organization for the loss of that person's efforts on other activities that he or she would otherwise be undertaking were it not for that secondment."@en ;
    rdfs:isDefinedBy frapo: ;
    vs:term_status reg:statusStable .

        pro:withRole frapo:entrepreneur .

estates costs
ni

back to ToC or Named Individual ToC

IRI: http://purl.org/cerif/frapo/estates-costs

comment
A budget category to cover the "overhead" costs of maintaining the premises in which work is undertaken.
en
is defined by
http://purl.org/cerif/frapo/
label
estates costs
en
type
budget categoryc
example
:my-budget a frapo:Budget ; frapo:hasBudgetInformation :my-budgeted-amout . :my-budgeted-amount a frapo:BudgetedAmount ; frapo:hasBudgetCategory frapo:estates-costs .
term status
status stable

@prefix frapo: <http://purl.org/cerif/frapo/> .
@prefix owl: <http://www.w3.org/2002/07/owl#> .
@prefix rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#> .
@prefix reg: <http://purl.org/linked-data/registry#> .
@prefix vann: <http://purl.org/vocab/vann/> .
@prefix vs: <http://www.w3.org/2003/06/sw-vocab-status/ns#> .

frapo:estates-costs a frapo:BudgetCategory,
        owl:NamedIndividual ;
    rdfs:label "estates costs"@en ;
    vann:example """
    :my-budget a frapo:Budget ;
        frapo:hasBudgetInformation :my-budgeted-amout .
    
    :my-budgeted-amount a frapo:BudgetedAmount ;
        frapo:hasBudgetCategory frapo:estates-costs .
    """ ;
    rdfs:comment "A budget category to cover the \"overhead\" costs of maintaining the premises in which work is undertaken."@en ;
    rdfs:isDefinedBy frapo: ;
    vs:term_status reg:statusStable .

funded

        pso:holdsStatusInTime :my-status-in-time .

        pso:withStatus frapo:funded .
    </vann:example>
  </rdf:Description>
</rdf:RDF>

indirect costs
ni

back to ToC or Named Individual ToC

IRI: http://purl.org/cerif/frapo/indirect-costs

comment
A budget category to cover the indirect costs of running a project, for example heating and lighting, and the employment of non-project staff including administrators, accountants and cleaners.
en
is defined by
http://purl.org/cerif/frapo/
label
indirect costs
en
type
budget categoryc
example
:my-budget a frapo:Budget ; frapo:hasBudgetInformation :my-budgeted-amout . :my-budgeted-amount a frapo:BudgetedAmount ; frapo:hasBudgetCategory frapo:indirect-costs .
term status
status stable

@prefix frapo: <http://purl.org/cerif/frapo/> .
@prefix owl: <http://www.w3.org/2002/07/owl#> .
@prefix rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#> .
@prefix reg: <http://purl.org/linked-data/registry#> .
@prefix vann: <http://purl.org/vocab/vann/> .
@prefix vs: <http://www.w3.org/2003/06/sw-vocab-status/ns#> .

frapo:indirect-costs a frapo:BudgetCategory,
        owl:NamedIndividual ;
    rdfs:label "indirect costs"@en ;
    vann:example """
    :my-budget a frapo:Budget ;
        frapo:hasBudgetInformation :my-budgeted-amout .
    
    :my-budgeted-amount a frapo:BudgetedAmount ;
        frapo:hasBudgetCategory frapo:indirect-costs .
    """ ;
    rdfs:comment "A budget category to cover the indirect costs of running a project, for example heating and lighting, and the employment of non-project staff including administrators, accountants and cleaners."@en ;
    rdfs:isDefinedBy frapo: ;
    vs:term_status reg:statusStable .

non-staff costs
ni

back to ToC or Named Individual ToC

IRI: http://purl.org/cerif/frapo/non-staff-costs

comment
A budget category to cover all the costs associated with a project that do not involve the employment of staff by the institution, thus, for example, including consumables purchase, travel costs and consultancy fees, but excluding the salary, estates and indirect costs associated with the allocation of the PI's time to the project and the direct employment of a project manager.
en
is defined by
http://purl.org/cerif/frapo/
label
non-staff costs
en
type
budget categoryc
example
:my-budget a frapo:Budget ; frapo:hasBudgetInformation :my-budgeted-amout . :my-budgeted-amount a frapo:BudgetedAmount ; frapo:hasBudgetCategory frapo:non-staff-costs .
term status
status stable

@prefix reg: <http://purl.org/linked-data/registry#> .
@prefix vann: <http://purl.org/vocab/vann/> .
@prefix vs: <http://www.w3.org/2003/06/sw-vocab-status/ns#> .

frapo:non-staff-costs a frapo:BudgetCategory,
        owl:NamedIndividual ;
    rdfs:label "non-staff costs"@en ;
    vann:example """
    :my-budget a frapo:Budget ;
        frapo:hasBudgetInformation :my-budgeted-amout .
    
    :my-budgeted-amount a frapo:BudgetedAmount ;
        frapo:hasBudgetCategory frapo:non-staff-costs .
    """ ;
    rdfs:comment "A budget category to cover all the costs associated with a project that do not involve the employment of staff by the institution, thus, for example, including consumables purchase, travel costs and consultancy fees, but excluding the salary, estates and indirect costs associated with the allocation of the PI's time to the project and the direct employment of a project manager."@en ;
    rdfs:isDefinedBy frapo: ;
    vs:term_status reg:statusStable .
